en.headline: Two people in their 70s die after charcoal burning at Tuen Mun estate
en.dek: Police said a man and woman found unconscious around 2.30pm on Sunday at Shan King Estate were later confirmed dead at Tuen Mun Hospital.
body: Two people in their 70s who were found unconscious after charcoal burning in a flat at Shan King Estate in Tuen Mun on Sunday afternoon have died, police said.

Officers received a report at about 2.30pm of a man and a woman unresponsive in a unit at King Wing House. Burnt charcoal was found nearby. Both were taken to Tuen Mun Hospital, where doctors later confirmed they had died.

Police said the man was 72 and the woman about 70. Investigators are examining their relationship and the circumstances of the incident. Preliminary inquiries are treating the case as a possible suicide pact. No one has been arrested.

zh.headline: 屯門山景邨一對約70歲男女燒炭後證實死亡
zh.dek: 警方指今午約2時30分在景榮樓發現兩人昏迷，身旁有燒過的炭，送屯門醫院後不治。
body: 屯門山景邨景榮樓一對約70歲男女今午被發現燒炭昏迷，送院後證實死亡。
警方指下午約2時30分接報，單位內一男一女昏迷，附近有已燒過的炭。兩人由救護車送往屯門醫院，其後由醫生證實身亡。
據了解男事主72歲、女事主約70歲。警方正調查兩人關係及事件起因，初步以自殺協定方向跟進，暫未有人被捕。
